sections.h2: Where is Charles County and what is its layout?
sections.html:
Charles County sits in Southern Maryland, with La Plata as the county seat and Waldorf as its largest community. It is bordered by Prince George's County to the north, Calvert and St. Mary's counties to the east and southeast, and several Virginia counties across the Potomac.

The county covers 643 square miles, but only 458 of them are land. The other 185 square miles, about 29 percent, are water, which is why creeks, swamps and shoreline show up in so many property descriptions. Nanjemoy Creek and Zekiah Swamp are two of the named features.

Charles County was created in 1658 and named for Charles Calvert, the third Baron Baltimore. Its population was 166,617 in the 2020 census, and the 2025 estimate cited by Wikipedia is 176,593, up 6.0 percent.

sections.h2: What towns and areas do Charles County sellers deal with?
sections.html:
Most sellers here fall into one of four settings: Waldorf, La Plata, Indian Head or the rural south and west. Each has its own buyer pool and its own tax picture.

  • Waldorf: a census-designated place about 23 miles south-southeast of Washington, D.C. It had 81,410 residents in 2020, up from fewer than 5,000 in 1980, largely because of the planned community of St. Charles that began after a 1970 federal loan package. U.S. Route 301 is its main commercial road and Maryland Route 5 starts there.
  • La Plata: the county seat, where the April 28, 2002 tornado (rated F-4) destroyed much of downtown and killed three people.
  • Indian Head: a town tied to the naval installation on the Potomac, which is the county's largest employer.
  • Rural Charles: places such as Nanjemoy, Port Tobacco Village, Newburg and Bryantown, where lots are larger, wells and septic are common, and water is never far away.

sections.h2: Who employs people in Charles County?
sections.html:
The Naval Surface Warfare Center and Naval Support Facility Indian Head is the largest employer in Charles County, followed by the public school system. The table below uses the 2022 employer ranking reported by Wikipedia.

Waldorf is also a bedroom community. Four MTA commuter bus routes (901, 903, 905 and 907) run between Waldorf and downtown Washington, D.C., and federal work, professional services and health care are the main jobs for commuters. A household that relies on a federal paycheck or a base contract may need to move on a fixed schedule, which is one reason some owners want a fast sale.

sections.h2: How is property tax billed in Charles County?
sections.html:
The Charles County Treasurer bills and collects real property tax, and full-year bills go out in July. Owners of a principal residence can split the bill: the first installment is due September 30, and the second, with the applicable service charge, is due December 31.

Supplemental bills for new construction or improvements are generally mailed in October (three-quarter year), January (half year) and April (quarter year). If a mortgage company pays your tax, send it your bill and check your escrow analysis to be sure it was paid.

  • Office: 200 Baltimore Street, La Plata, MD 20646. Mail goes to P.O. Box 2607.
  • Phone: 301-645-0685
  • Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. The Waldorf payment center closes from 11:15 a.m. to 12:15 p.m. each day.
  • Assessment questions: the State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT) sets values; the county page gives 301-932-2440 for questions.

The county page says delinquent properties may be offered at the annual tax sale held each May. The state tax sale schedule for 2026 lists Charles County on May 12.

sections.h2: What property tax rates apply in Charles County towns?
sections.html:
A house in unincorporated Charles County carried a total real property rate of 1.2050 per $100 of assessed value in the fiscal 2025 state table, and towns add their own rate on top. The figures below come from the Department of Legislative Services table built from SDAT data.

The county special rate is 0.0640 in the unincorporated area and in the municipalities listed, and the table shows Port Tobacco at a total of 1.2450. The rate is applied to the taxable assessment divided by 100, so a bill is easy to check with a calculator.

Maryland's state tables also list a Charles County transfer tax of 0.5 percent and a recordation tax figure of $5.00 for fiscal 2025 and $7.00 for fiscal 2026. Ask the title company for the exact charges on your closing statement.

sections.h2: What credits and appeal rights can reduce a Charles County bill?
sections.html:
Charles County lists several credits, and the State Department of Assessments and Taxation reviews the applications. They include the Homestead Tax Credit, the Homeowners' Property Tax Credit (income based), a senior tax credit and an exemption for 100 percent disabled veterans. The county page also lists credits for a perpetual conservation easement, for the surviving spouse of a fallen EMS officer and for volunteer emergency responders.

If you think the value is too high, the state appeal path applies in Charles County as it does elsewhere in Maryland.

  1. File with the Supervisor of Assessments within 45 days of the notice date, online with the control number on the notice or on paper.
  2. If you disagree with the result, appeal to the Property Tax Assessment Appeals Board within 30 days of the Supervisor's final notice. There is no fee.
  3. Take the case to the Maryland Tax Court within 30 days of the board's order. Hearings there are in person and start fresh.

A buyer who purchases a house transferred between January 1 and June 30 can also appeal within 60 days of the transfer date, provided the deed has been recorded.

sections.h2: What does flood risk mean for a Charles County house?
sections.html:
Charles County tries to keep its floodplain open so water can spread out and move downstream, and a house inside a mapped Special Flood Hazard Area is treated differently from one outside it. The county's floodplain page states plainly that homeowners insurance does not cover flood damage and that residents can buy a National Flood Insurance Program policy through an insurance agent.

With 29 percent of the county's total area in water, owners near the Potomac, creeks and swamps should expect a buyer's lender to ask about flood zone status. Check the FEMA map for the parcel before listing, and have any flood insurance paperwork ready. Flood status can also affect the price a buyer offers.

sections.h2: What happens if Charles County property tax goes unpaid?
sections.html:
Unpaid property tax in Maryland becomes a lien, and the county can sell that lien at public auction. The owner keeps the house, but the buyer gains the right to collect and eventually to ask a court to foreclose.

The Maryland tax sale ombudsman's page explains the main steps:

  • The collector mails a notice at least 30 days before the property is first advertised, and the listing runs weekly for four weeks.
  • An owner can redeem at any time until a court finally forecloses the right to redeem, and costs grow the longer the owner waits.
  • The buyer may file for foreclosure after six months, or nine months for an owner-occupied home, and the certificate is void if no case is filed within two years.

When a house is sold before that point, the title company normally pays the tax from the sale proceeds. The ombudsman's office can be reached at 410-767-4994, and its Homeowner Protection Program helps limited-income, elderly and disabled homeowners.

faqs.q: When is Charles County property tax due?
faqs.a: Full-year bills are mailed in July, and principal residence owners can pay in two parts: September 30 and December 31, with a service charge on the second. Check the Treasurer's page for the current year, because interest rates and the service charge amount were not shown on the county page we read.

faqs.q: Who do I call about a Charles County property tax bill?
faqs.a: Call the Charles County Treasurer at 301-645-0685 for billing, or visit 200 Baltimore Street in La Plata on a weekday between 8:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. For the assessed value itself, the county page points to SDAT at 301-932-2440.

faqs.q: What is the tax rate in La Plata compared with unincorporated Charles County?
faqs.a: In the fiscal 2025 state table, La Plata totals 1.4130 per $100 and the unincorporated area totals 1.2050. Indian Head totals 1.5060. Rates change each year, so confirm the current figure before relying on it.

faqs.q: Can I sell my Charles County house if the tax is behind?
faqs.a: Yes. A sale can close with the tax paid out of the proceeds, and it can happen before a tax sale or while the lien is still open for redemption. The payoff amount changes with interest and fees, so ask the Treasurer or the title company for a current figure.

faqs.q: Does Charles County have a tax sale every year?
faqs.a: The county page says delinquent properties may be sold at the annual tax sale held each May, and the state's 2026 schedule shows May 12. A property is sold only if the account is still unpaid at that point.
